reviewer: Codex visual inspection in original-resolution image viewer
scope: Every complete finished PNG, all ten rows, all archived frames and recorded goals; not all 800 selected evaluation trajectories
layout_findings: No overlapping text, missing glyphs, introduced cropping, or illegible labels observed. Empty columns on short rollouts are intentional. Source camera occlusion/edge truncation is preserved.
case_mapping: NPZ stems are original case-plan indices, not lexicographically sorted report positions; reconstructed order verified against report case-plan SHA256.
limitations: These are first ten case-plan indices, not selected successes or a representative sample.
Success labels are recorded native outcomes; visual review is not a replacement evaluation or an independent numeric success audit.
No intermediate frames were synthesized; original 224-pixel images are preserved in NPZ and displayed at 176 pixels with Lanczos resizing.
Single seed, development checkpoint selection, different trained systems/custom ports and backbone exposure prevent causal-component, generalization or SOTA claims.
